subject: Molly's 3AM wake-up call that changed everything
preview_text: One owner's midnight realization about her dog's weight — and how a simple app feature turned it around.
body_paragraphs: At 3AM last Tuesday, Sarah sat on her kitchen floor watching Molly — her 8-year-old Beagle — struggle to climb onto the couch. She'd been telling herself Molly was 'just getting older.' But that night, she saw the truth: Molly's belly was dragging, her breathing was labored, and she couldn't jump like she used to. Sound familiar?

Sarah had tried everything — expensive vet diets, guessing portion sizes, even cutting treats cold turkey. Nothing stuck. Then she found PupShape. She started by logging Molly's weight, breed, and age into the app. Within minutes, it gave her a custom meal plan — no more guesswork. The calorie calculator helped her see that Molly's 'healthy' kibble was actually 300 calories over per day.

Here's the part that hit home: the app's progress tracking showed her a tiny win on Day 3 — Molly's first 0.5 pound drop. That small victory kept her going. By week 8, Molly had lost 15% of her body weight and was chasing squirrels again. Sarah says she got her best friend back. That feature you might not have tried yet? The before/after photo timeline. It's not just for showing off — it's your daily reminder that you're doing right by your dog.

Open PupShape now and snap a photo of your dog from today. Then set your first weight milestone. It takes 30 seconds. P.S. — Sarah's texted me twice this week about how Molly now sleeps through the night without snoring. That's the kind of win waiting for you.
